name: Jim Himes
stance: Says AI is powerful and dangerous, that keeping a human in the loop in military use is a priority, and criticizes congressional inaction on AI regulation.

statements.text: I watched Speaker Johnson on the Sunday shows this morning make yet another set of excuses for Congressional inaction on AI.

I do know that AI is tremendously powerful but it can also be tremendously dangerous. Making sure we employ these tools in a smart way that keeps a human in the loop is a day one priority for House Democrats.
